description: This file defines an API endpoint for searching content within a FastAPI application. It sets up a router, defines a GET endpoint at '/search', and performs a search query on a database using SQLAlchemy ORM. The search function filters Content objects based on a query string, considering title, tags, and text fields.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to define API routes.

methods.name: search(q: Optional[str] = None, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), current=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs a content search based on query parameter, filtering by title, tags, and text fields.
